entries.title: Today's Lunch Service "E" Schedule
entries.text: Upper School food service will start at 11:45am today to allow Lower School to eat. Only pre-ordered food may be picked up in the Dining Hall prior to 11:45 am. Thank you for your patience.

SHAKESPEARE COMPETITION! The time has come for our Shakespeare Competition! Come today, during meeting period, C-107 to cheer on your peers! They will be performing monologues from Shakespeare's plays for you all and a panel of judges. The winner of our competition will continue on to the state level for a chance at competing at the English Speaking Union's National Competition in New York City!

entries.title: NAMI Club Event
entries.text: Take a breather and join NAMI tomorrow, Wed, 11/25, during mtg pd and lunch at the Arillaga Takaki Terrace Floor Commons for a relaxing afternoon of cookie decorating! We’re featuring the viral TikTok dot cookie trend alongside a variety of other classic sugar cookie flavors and frostings. Bring a friend and unwind with us!

GIVE THANKS AND BRING YOUR APPETITE! Get ready to celebrate Thanksgiving with some friendly competition, festive fun, and plenty of holiday spirit! Join us on the Pā tomorrow, Wed, 11/25, for our Thanksgiving Celebration, featuring a crowd favorite: the Pumpkin Pie Eating Contest!

entries.title: The Pumpkin Pie Eating Contest
entries.text: Tomorrow, Wed, 11/25. Think you have what it takes to claim the title? Watch 8 contestants go head-to-head in a battle for pumpkin pie supremacy! We will have 2 faculty/staff, and 6 students, with one from each grade. Please complete the attached form. If more than one student from each grade signs up, we will default to a first-come first-serve basis, choosing the first student that signs up from that grade.Bring your friends and something to be thankful for. Cheer on your classmates and teachers, and join us in celebrating the holiday of gratitude. LAST DAY FOR FOOD DRIVE & ONETEAM.PERIOD DRIVE: Tomorrow, Wed, 11/25 is the last day to bring in your donations for the Thanksgiving Food Drive and OneTeam.PERIOD Drive to support Aloha Harvest and the Institute for Human Services, IHS. Please bring all donations to the autoline tomorrow morning before school. We appreciate your efforts to address the immediate needs of our community! NEW HUNGER STATS & FOOD4THOUGHT: Along with the alarming stats we learned yesterday (52% are ALICE), the same report revealed that 37% of Hawaiʻi households face food insecurity. This is even higher than the levels (e.g., one-in-three) we have seen historically. These findings come at a critical moment. Our communities are facing numerous challenges, and any and all support for community partners and services – like those that Aloha Harvest and IHS provide – can make a difference this Thanksgiving, and beyond. DISPLAYS AROUND CAMPUS: Don’t miss the Castle bulletin board and the wall outside the Community & Civic Engagement (C+CE) Office, Sullivan 405! These Food4Thought displays from our students in English 7 and My Life, My Island, My World are eye-opening.
VIRTUAL POP-UP! Get your Young Entrepreneurs Club Virtual Pop-up pre-orders in before it's too late! Pickup will be Monday, November 30.

GOT AN IDEA WORTH SHARING? Step onto the ‘Iolani TEDEd stage. Come to the TEDEd Speaker Interest Meeting on Tuesday, December 1st during lunch in ASC-301 to learn how YOU can speak at this year’s ‘Iolani TEDed Event in April! Open to all 9th-12th grade students interested in presenting a short talk to an audience on their unique passions, insights, interests, curiosities, and perspectives. If you are interested but unable to attend the kick-off meeting, email Mr. Andrews (jandrews@iolani.org).

entries.title: Pizza & Pasta Food Drive Challenge
entries.text: Tomorrow is THE DAY to complete our Pizza & Pasta meal together! Drop off your donations at LS and US autolines or in your homeroom collection boxes. Please remember to report your donations to your homeroom teacher for a chance to win your homeroom a warm and cozy breakfast featuring homemade pasta e fagioli and fresh-baked bread.

entries.title: Lā Kūʻokoʻa (HAWIIAN INDEPENDENCE DAY)
entries.text: All 8th graders have a mandatory event to celebrate Lā Kūʻokoʻa (Hawaiian Independence Day) today, Tue. Nov 24 in Seto during the meeting period, beginning at 10:45 am and ending at 11:40 am.

entries.title: Biology Club
entries.text: How does the genetic code of life clone itself? Come model DNA replication using candy at the BioClub mtg tomorrow, Wed, 11/25 during mtg pd. Snacks are provided; bring friends.

entries.title: Filipino Club
entries.text: MOVIE & JOLLIBEE! Thanksgiving is almost here, and we're celebrating Filipino Club style! Join us for a fun afternoon of Jollibee and a movie! We'll be watching Forgotten Island while enjoying some delicious Jollibee! Tomorrow, Wed, Nov 25, during lunch & meeting period, N-208. IMPORTANT: This event is for PAID Filipino Club members ONLY! Come hungry, bring your friends from the club, and enjoy some Filipino food, fun, and fellowship before Thanksgiving break! Questions? Feel free to reach out! Hope to see you there!

entries.title: Japanese Tea Club
entries.text: Meeting receive tea and okashi TODAY, Tuesday, 11/24 in I 217 during meeting period. Please bring $5 dues.

entries.title: Mahjong Club
entries.text: Join us on today, Tues, 11/24 for a Mahjong Club mtg during lunch! Take a break, catch up with friends, and enjoy a few rounds of mahjong. Hope to see you there!

entries.title: Pacific Pride Club
entries.text: Calling all Pacific Stride Club members! We have TWO fun running events coming up this Thanksgiving week! Check your email from the club officers for details and sign-up information! Tomorrow, WED, 11/25 – TURKEY TROT RELAY & ALA MOANA RUN, Location: ‘Iolani Track Time: 3:20 PM (arrive with your entire team!) Get your team of FOUR together for a fun Turkey Trot Relay! Each runner completes 400 meters (one lap). Thanksgiving-themed running attire is optional but HIGHLY encouraged! Get festive! The team showing the MOST improvement in its relay time at our next event will win a small prize! BONUS RUN! After the Turkey Trot, we'll run to Ala Moana! Bring money if you'd like to purchase food. THURS, 11/26 – IHS HOMEWARD BOUND 5K. Start your Thanksgiving morning with a meaningful run supporting the Institute for Human Services (IHS)! Location: Mānoa Valley District Park, 2721 Kaʻaipu Avenue. Time: 7:00 AM. Registration is required! Please refer to the email from your club officers for registration details. Questions? Contact aja2901@iolani.org or Auntie Lei at lei@iolani.org. Lace up your running shoes, grab your friends, and let's make this a fun Thanksgiving week of running!

entries.title: Philosophy Club
entries.text: Calling all philosophers! Our long-awaited November meeting will take place tomorrow, Wed, 11/25 during mtg pd, ASC-207, and we are joined by Mr. Buchanan as our guest speaker! In this meeting, we will be covering a question as old as time: "Can harming innocent persons be justified by beneficial results to others?" If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to Tata Li (tl2701@iolani.org) or Arina Shumilova (avs2701@iolani.org). We hope to see you there!

entries.title: Puzzles and Games Club
entries.text: Discover new challenges and make new friends at the Puzzles and Games Club! Dive into exciting card and board games like Avalon, Coup, Camel up, Set, Skull, Stratego, Chess, Uno, SushiGo, Love Letter, Decrypto, and more. Everyone is welcome to join the fun during mtg and lunch pd today, Tues, 11/24, W-308. Bring your lunch, and bring along friends!
